name: print-social-3d-glass-tag-event-invitation-poster-blue
title: Blue invitation with frosted arrow-tag 'You Are Invited', 3D hourglass, calendar and QR cards
whatItIs: A royal blue portrait with a subtle maze pattern, logos at top, three frosted arrow-shaped tags stacking 'You Are Invited', 3D icons (hourglass with green sand, green calendar '6 Jun', check, arrow), three feature icons, two QR cards (RSVP, maps) and two info cards (When, Where).
whatItMeans: Clear and modern; glass tags and 3D icons make a corporate invite feel light.
techniques: Stack the headline on frosted directional tags.
Use glossy 3D icons as event motifs.
Give QR codes their own cards.

vocabulary.definition: A card containing a scan code and label.
A rounded card with when or where.
